scope: Create a fresh reviewable two-parent ancestry-integration candidate of exact canonical main into the paused exact ECO head, prove the candidate removes aggregate ECO PC0 RED without changing the ECO source tree, open a draft PR targeting ECO, and stop before that PR is merged.
required_outputs: Pre-merge RED diagnosis and synthetic post-merge NON_RED report
stop_conditions: origin/main, ECO source, passport blob, or source dry-merge tree moves at any point through merge creation, synthetic PC0, evidence, exact review, draft PR, or human merge
Unexpected merge tree delta appears outside this Work Order's append-only control records
Synthetic standard PC0 remains RED or directional PC0 becomes RED
Any runtime, passport, ecology, registry, or architecture edit is required
CONTROL_DOCS_ONLY_MERGE approval has not been granted
risk_reasons: Dependency integration changes ECO branch ancestry and PC0 critical-drift evaluation.
A false synthetic non-RED verdict could incorrectly unblock H0.0.
The candidate preserves the exact ECO source tree apart from append-only R3 control records and changes no runtime, identity, ownership, or foundation contract, so CRITICAL triggers are absent.

design_brief.problem_statement: R2 correctly stopped at the human gate but became stale when ECO advanced from 67e23224 to 2a4c3103. The current ECO merge-base with main is still 790fd79f, so stale R2 evidence cannot authorize ancestry integration for the new target.
design_brief.current_behavior: Exact main is 5ba1dcb7 at registry generation 66; exact ECO is 2a4c3103. R3 source-tree reconstruction proves tree b78d75da is byte-identical to the current ECO head. A GitHub merge probe shows the only main-to-ECO content delta is the main-owned project registry, so ancestry must be integrated without silently replacing current ECO content.
design_brief.desired_behavior: A fresh two-parent commit has the exact R3 pre-merge control head as first parent and exact main 5ba1dcb7 as second parent, while retaining the exact first-parent tree. Synthetic exact refs must then make aggregate PC0 NON_RED with no directional RED before any draft ECO-targeted PR is eligible for human review.
alternatives_considered: Copy or overwrite the registry again
Use GitHub UI merge and accept its registry content delta
Create a fresh reviewed tree-preserving two-parent ancestry candidate
design_brief.selected_design: Preserve R2 as terminal historical evidence. Start R3 from exact paused ECO 2a4c3103, pin main/passport/source-tree identities, preserve source content, append only R3 control records, create a two-parent commit with the R3 control head first and exact main second, verify synthetic PC0 in a fresh topology, and open only a draft PR targeting ECO.
design_brief.why_selected: This keeps ECO research history and current evidence intact, integrates canonical ancestry instead of rewriting history, avoids force-push and stale evidence reuse, and leaves the actual ECO merge behind the explicit CONTROL_DOCS_ONLY_MERGE gate.
non_goals: No ECO runtime or research edit
No C22 or NX runtime work
expected_risks: Accidental reuse of R2 PASS evidence
validation_plan: Re-read and require exact main/ECO/passport/source-tree identities before merge creation, synthetic PC0, evidence, exact review, draft PR, and human merge.
Retain R2 as EPOCH_INVALIDATED and never use its review/verifier/PC0 results as R3 predicates.
Prove reconstructed source tree b78d75da equals exact ECO 2a4c3103 with a zero-file compare.
Pin the exact pre-merge R3 control head; prove its first-parent ancestry contains exact ECO and its source delta contains only allowed R3 control records.
Create a two-parent ancestry commit; assert parents are exact pre-merge head then exact main and candidate tree equals immediate first-parent tree.
Prove source-to-candidate changes avoid runtime, passport, registry, ecology, and architecture surfaces except append-only R3 execution records.
In a fresh topology, set only a disposable synthetic ECO ref to the exact candidate while keeping origin/main exact; run standard and directional PC0.
Require standard aggregate NON_RED and directional no RED; perform independent exact-head review and verification before draft PR.
Open only a draft PR targeting ECO and stop in WAITING_HUMAN for CONTROL_DOCS_ONLY_MERGE.

notes: R1 and R2 remain terminal EPOCH_INVALIDATED. R3 is fresh and may proceed autonomously only through a reviewed draft PR; no ECO merge and no runtime work are authorized.
